title: The Secret of Recognition (Pratyabhijnahrdayam)
author: Kshemaraja (Leidecker trans)
description: Kshemaraja introduces the philosophy of recognition within Kashmir Shaivism: the discovery of consciousness as the ground of experience. This edition offers an entry point into its account of manifestation, limitation and spiritual freedom.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/dli.csl.3497).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
